name: Zynaps: effectdata
summary: The sound effects and the sprite descriptors of the ship, the shots and the explosions.

labels.name: EffectTable
labels.comment: The 6 sound effects, 8 bytes each, from effect 1

labels.name: ShipDescriptor
labels.comment: The sprite descriptor of the ship (record $F36C +0/+1)

labels.name: ExplosionAnim
labels.comment: The explosion's sprite and animation record

labels.name: PodAnim
labels.comment: The weapon pod's sprite and animation record

labels.name: LaserDescriptor
labels.comment: The laser shot's sprite descriptor (the four records from $F4F8)

labels.name: ShotDescriptor
labels.comment: The enemy shot's and the plasma ball's sprite descriptor

labels.name: SpriteCache
labels.comment: The sprite cache: record 0 and records 1-6, 16 bytes each

labels.name: SpriteCacheRecord1
labels.comment: record 1 (the use count +$0D at $7EFF, the search's first)

labels.name: SpriteCacheUse1
labels.comment: record 1's use count, the search's start ($93B3) and LevelSetUp's ($8D22)

labels.name: SpareCacheRecord
labels.comment: A seventh record of the same layout, out of the search (B = 6)
